ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given a right-angled $\triangle ABC$, with $\angle C=90^\circ$, $\angle A=50^\circ$, and $AB=2$, what is the value of $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: We have $\angle B=90^\circ-\angle A=90^\circ-50^\circ=40^\circ$,\\
Furthermore, since $\sin B= \frac{AC}{AB}$,\\
it follows that $AC=AB \cdot \sin 40^\circ = \boxed{2\sin 40^\circ}$.
